about_the_game:
Headmaster:​​ "Congratulations, Class. You've graduated. But you will not leave this school. The year is 2033 AD. Outside these walls, 30 billion souls fight over scraps in a world that collapsed three years ago. You are not saviors; you are burdens. Society cannot bear you.

​​However...​​ The Human Purification Act grants one student from Class A the privilege – or curse – of stepping into the desolation. Only the most exceptional may pass. The rest? They will remain here forever... preserved as perfect specimens of a lost generation.

​​So fight.​​ Claw your way to the top. Prove you are worthy of survival. Prove you are the one."

​​Experience the Brutal Elegance of [Graduation Game] - A Unique 4-Player Battle Royale​​

  • ​​Survive the Last School Standing:​​ Trapped in your crumbling alma mater, compete against three classmates in a high-stakes struggle for the sole escape.

  • ​​Deception is Your Weapon :​​ Forge alliances, break promises, and outwit rivals. Built-in voice chat fuels the tension – trust is fleeting, betrayal is survival.

  • ​​Play Your Way:​​ Jump into existing sessions or create your own private room to invite friends into this desperate graduation ceremony.

  • ​​Become the Exemplar... or the Exhibit:​​ Will you earn the right to face the horrors outside, or will you become a permanent, pristine relic of the past?

​​The Ultimate Question: Are You Exceptional Enough to Deserve the World?​​
